title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 7 — WORLD 9: C1 ADVANCED FLUENCY & REAL-WORLD MASTERY
description: A high-level real-world English mastery world focused on spontaneous fluency, nuanced communication, complex situations, and independent performance across everyday, professional, academic, and global contexts.

targets.vocabulary: 4300+ active words and high-frequency C1 collocations
targets.reading: 2300–3000 words with inference, stance, tone, and synthesis
targets.listening: 24–30 minutes of authentic multi-speaker and fast-paced English
targets.speaking: 28–38 minutes of spontaneous, interactive C1 communication
targets.writing: 900–1100 words across practical, analytical, and persuasive tasks
targets.presentation: 14–18 minute structured presentation with unscripted Q&A

grammar: Advanced tense and aspect choices for viewpoint and emphasis
Modal and semi-modal systems for probability, obligation, criticism, and deduction
Modal perfects in nuanced real and hypothetical contexts
Complex conditional and mixed conditional structures
Participial and reduced clauses for concise communication
Advanced relative clauses, apposition, and complex noun phrases
Ellipsis, substitution, parallelism, and discourse cohesion
Concession, qualification, hedging, boosting, and stance control
Register shifting and pragmatic grammar choices

missions.title: Real-World Fluency Engine
missions.focus: Build spontaneous C1 responses through rapid vocabulary retrieval, paraphrase, and flexible sentence formation.

missions.title: Nuance & Meaning Control
missions.focus: Distinguish subtle differences in certainty, attitude, implication, intensity, and interpersonal meaning.

missions.title: Spontaneous Conversation Lab
missions.focus: Maintain natural conversations while responding, clarifying, reformulating, and extending ideas without scripts.

missions.title: Difficult Conversation Arena
missions.focus: Handle disagreement, criticism, misunderstanding, and sensitive topics with precise and diplomatic English.

missions.title: Decision & Advice Command
missions.focus: Compare options, explain trade-offs, give qualified recommendations, and defend decisions under pressure.

missions.title: Storytelling & Perspective Lab
missions.focus: Use advanced tense, aspect, emphasis, and narrative structure to tell complex stories and control perspective.

missions.title: Problem-Solving War Room
missions.focus: Collaboratively diagnose problems, challenge assumptions, propose solutions, and negotiate priorities.

missions.title: Negotiation & Persuasion Lab
missions.focus: Use persuasive language, concessions, hedging, framing, and strategic questions in complex negotiations.

missions.title: Cross-Cultural Communication Arena
missions.focus: Adapt tone, directness, politeness, and conversational strategy across international communication contexts.

missions.title: High-Stakes Conversation Mission
missions.focus: Sustain clear, calm, and precise communication during interviews, complaints, urgent requests, and difficult questions.

missions.title: Authentic Reading Intelligence
missions.focus: Analyze long-form authentic texts for argument, tone, assumptions, evidence, implication, and author stance.

missions.title: Fast Listening Command
missions.focus: Understand natural-speed speech, reduced forms, interruptions, multiple speakers, implied meaning, and changing viewpoints.

missions.title: Real-World Writing Studio
missions.focus: Produce polished messages, explanations, complaints, proposals, and responses with appropriate tone and structure.

missions.title: Argument & Counterargument Lab
missions.focus: Build balanced arguments, acknowledge limitations, address counterclaims, and control claim strength precisely.

missions.title: Presentation Under Pressure
missions.focus: Deliver a structured presentation and handle unexpected audience questions with spontaneous C1 responses.

missions.title: Media & Information Reality Lab
missions.focus: Interpret headlines, interviews, commentary, claims, framing, and competing perspectives in modern media.

missions.title: Global Life Simulation
missions.focus: Navigate travel, services, work, education, technology, healthcare, and social situations through integrated English tasks.

missions.title: Independent English Challenge
missions.focus: Complete a multi-stage mission with minimal scaffolding, selecting strategies and language independently.

missions.title: World 9 Integrated Fluency Marathon
missions.focus: Combine advanced vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking, writing, and presentation skills in one continuous challenge.

missions.title: WORLD 9 MASTER QUEST — C1 ADVANCED FLUENCY & REAL-WORLD MASTERY
missions.focus: Complete an end-to-end C1 real-world simulation requiring spontaneous communication, interpretation, decision-making, writing, negotiation, and presentation.

realWorldScenarios: Professional email, proposal, and report communication

assessment.masteryStandard: Learner can communicate independently and effectively across complex real-world contexts, adapting language, register, tone, and strategy with C1-level control.
